official_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing regular undergraduate and postgraduate degree courses.
government_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_audience: Meritorious Class XII pass-out students pursuing regular higher education degrees
benefit_amount_annual: ₹12,000/year for first 3 years of UG; ₹20,000/year for PG / 4th-5th year

official_name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students (Karnataka SSP)
description: Comprehensive financial support provided to Scheduled Caste students of Karnataka pursuing post-matric and undergraduate education, covering 100% compulsory non-refundable fees and annual academic maintenance allowances.
government_department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka & Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_audience: SC domicile students enrolled in recognized post-matric / undergraduate colleges
benefit_amount_annual: 100% Compulsory Tuition & Exam Fee Concession + ₹4,000 to ₹13,500/year Academic Maintenance Allowance via DBT

official_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
description: Scheme to provide encouragement and support to meritorious young women to pursue technical higher education (Degree level in Engineering/Technology, Architecture, Pharmacy, etc.) in AICTE-approved institutions.
government_department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_audience: Female students admitted to 1st year Degree (or 2nd year lateral entry) in AICTE approved institutions
benefit_amount_annual: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study (max 4 years) towards college fees, books, equipment, and laptop purchase
